# X360 Mobile 0.6.5

This update focuses on more reliable profile and save imports, together with improvements to graphics processing and performance.

## Profiles and saved games

- Improved import reliability, including backups created with earlier versions of X360 Mobile.
- Clearer previews and confirmation before replacing existing profile or saved-game data.
- Stronger checks and recovery when an import is cancelled or interrupted, helping protect existing data.
- Preserves the original profile and saved-game ownership when restoring backups.

## Graphics and performance

- Improved graphics-work scheduling and reduced avoidable processing overhead.
- Added and refined graphics optimizations, evaluated using **GTA IV on Odin 2**.
- Further improvements to graphics-resource handling and pipeline reliability.

Two graphics optimizations are now **enabled by default**. Previously saved choices to disable them, including per-game overrides, continue to be respected. Both options can still be turned off.

Performance gains depend on the game, device, driver and settings. Other experimental graphics optimizations remain **opt-in**. Testing across other games and GPU families is still limited.

## Updating

- Existing installations can update in place and keep their games, settings, profiles and saves. There is no need to uninstall first.
- Existing preferences and per-game overrides are preserved.
- TV mode and synchronized player profiles remain highly experimental and may still have issues.
- X360 Companion is unchanged.
